newsitem.title: FRANCE: French say Russia to repay tsarist debt in 4 yrs.
newsitem.headline: French say Russia to repay tsarist debt in 4 yrs.

text.p: Russian tsarist-era debt will be repaid to French bondholders in four years, a French foreign ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
"The Russian bonds will be repaid in four years," spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt told reporters.

Prime Minister Alain Juppe and his Russian oppposite number Viktor Chernomyrdin reached agreement on Tuesday on repayment of $400 million to some 400,000 holders of the bonds which were issued before the 1917 Bolshvik revolution.
It had not previously been clear how long the repayment would take.
